description: This file exports constants and modules related to an ER (Entity-Relationship) diagram tool, including functions for drawing diagrams, managing entities and relationships, and parsing ER diagram syntax.

classes.name: Parser
classes.description: A parser class for implementing syntax parsing of ER diagram language.

classes.name: R
classes.description: A class encapsulating the parser state and methods for parsing ER diagram syntax.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Function to render ER diagrams using D3.js, creating SVG elements with specific markers and styles.

methods.name: setConf
methods.description: Method to set configuration for ER diagram rendering, such as layout direction, margins, and styles.

methods.name: addEntity
methods.description: Method to add a new entity to the diagram model.

methods.name: addAttributes
methods.description: Method to add attributes to a specific entity.

methods.name: getEntities
methods.description: Retrieve all entities in the current diagram.

methods.name: addRelationship
methods.description: Add a relationship between two entities in the diagram.

methods.name: getRelationships
methods.description: Retrieve all relationships in the current diagram.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clear all diagram data to start anew.

methods.name: setAccTitle
methods.description: Set the accessibility title of the diagram.

methods.name: setAccDescription
methods.description: Set the accessibility description of the diagram.

methods.name: setDiagramTitle
methods.description: Set the title of the diagram.
